name: interchange-demo
description: Interchange: vendor-neutral integration platform and API gateway. Public showcase + live demo.

paragraphs: Interchange is a vendor-neutral integration platform and API gateway. It is the single governed junction for all your external systems: partners never touch your core, and every request passes through one controlled point where it is authenticated, validated, rate-limited, and logged.

whatItDoes.text: Interchange is a vendor-neutral integration platform and API gateway. It is the single governed junction for all your external systems: partners never touch your core, and every request passes through one controlled point where it is authenticated, validated, rate-limited, and logged.

requirements.text: Log in with one click and use the whole console: register connectors, activate systems, run jobs and watch them flow through the lifecycle, receive notifications, browse the audit trail.

Credential lifecycle: issue API keys, bearer tokens and Basic credentials (optional label and expiry), rotate with an optional grace window, revoke, and list with Active, Rotating, Expired and Revoked status; store, rotate and revoke outbound credentials; labels are unique per system; revealing a stored outbound secret is off by default and needs both a permission and a server…

Admin console with working sign-in, permission-based access control (checked against the database on every request, 8 hour sessions, throttled sign-in), and pages for systems, catalog, jobs, schedules and audit.
